remarks: Welcome to 1058 Doverfield Avenue, a charming Hacienda Heights home where your own backyard resort awaits. This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers approximately 1,458 sq ft of living space plus a versatile bonus room, perfect for a home office, gym, playroom, or guest space. Step outside and discover the true showstopper: a sparkling swimming pool set in a private oasis backyard, ideal for summer barbecues, weekend gatherings, or quiet evenings unwinding at home. Sitting on a generous lot of approximately 6,100 sq ft, there’s room to relax, entertain, and make it your own.
